correctness.rationale: For a generic Gaussian normal, all crossed-edge hyperplane vertices are ±vij with norm sqrt(Xi²+Xj²)/(Xi+Xj). Thus min vertex radius R=(1/sqrt2)sqrt(1+Z²) for minimum normalized gap Z, while known section diameter is from min and max half-normal Xi. Small-gap pair probability is 4δ/π+o(δ); factorial-moment overlap graphs decay as O(n^-1), proving n²Z converges to Exp(2/π). Conditioning on minimum Xi>t/n retains iid truncated half-normals and the same asymptotic Poisson rate, establishing independence from n minXi. Gaussian max normalization and Taylor/Slutsky yield independently E~Exp(1/sqrtπ) for n sqrt(log n)(2-D) and W²/(2sqrt2) for n^4(R-1/sqrt2), W~Exp(2/π). Checked constants algebraically; no bounded simulation offered as asymptotic proof.
residual_risks: Bounded computations are not proofs of all-parameter or asymptotic theorems.
